name: Re-engagement
description: Win back inactive subscribers with a friendly nudge.
html_content:
We miss you, {first_name}

It's been a while since we last saw you, and we wanted to check in.

A lot has changed since you were last active:

  • A redesigned interface that's much easier to use
  • New automations that save hours each week
  • Better reporting to help you make decisions

If you'd like to take another look, log in any time — your account is still here.

If you'd rather not hear from us, no hard feelings — you can unsubscribe at any time.

— The {company_name} Team
